speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for your cooperation. To begin, how long have you noticed this breast mass, and has its size changed recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text: Has the mass been associated with any pain, nipple discharge, or skin changes like dimpling or redness? Do you have any swollen lymph nodes in your left armpit?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Presence of a left breast mass. I also have Rapid increase in size of the mass, No skin or nipple changes, No pain associated with the mass.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Phyllodes Tumor. Given the rapid growth and lack of inflammatory signs in a 48-year-old woman, this is highly suggestive of a fibroepithelial neoplasm rather than carcinoma or an abscess. Please proceed with a breast ultrasound and core needle biopsy for definitive histological confirmation.
